meta.parties: De Saram v. De Silva Et Al

rules.statement: A Court has no power to enlarge the period given by section 84 of the Civil Procedure Code within which a plaintiff is bound to show cause against a decree nisi entered against him being made absolute.
rules.supporting_quote: "A Court has no power to enlarge the period given by section 84 of the Civil Procedure Code within which a plaintiff is bound to show cause against a decree nisi entered against him being made absolute."
